caveats: Adapter was trained on this exact 5x5 GridWorld distribution; results show in-distribution memorization, not generalization.
All gate metrics are trivially satisfied when G1=1.0 because the pragmatic term dominates EFE.
Drive-system exploration value cannot be measured in this environment because there is no model uncertainty to drive exploration.
Use subprocess isolation because single-process multi-episode real-LLM runs hang intermittently.
Pareto frontier from real-LLM verification of top-5 stub weights: all 5 configs achieved 100% success and 0 revisit; the only differentiator was mean steps.
recommendation_note: Selected from real-LLM verification of top-5 stub Pareto weights (2 episodes each). Recommended because it achieved lowest mean steps with 100% success and 0 revisit. Note: because G1=1.0, drive weights have negligible effect; this recommendation is a tie-breaker, not evidence that the drive system is necessary for navigation.
phase1_status_note: All three formal gates pass on the 5x5 Grid World. However, the prediction-error-driven exploration mechanism could not be validated in this environment because the World Model is too certain (epistemic error approximately 0) on both clean and held-out obstacle grids. PEDA and pragmatic-only planning behave identically. Mechanism validation requires a richer environment such as Phase 2 sandbox or TextWorld.
